changelog.0.90.0:
Horizon missile shooting at friendly ships 😦 is fixed
 Loud engine sounds of fighters
 Changes:
 some major changes to ship OP values so base variants can equip all base weapons and asgard hullmods
 added ships to UNSF faction so you now can buy Prometheus, Daedalus, Daedalus refit, Helios in store and should show up as fleets around sector
 MAJOR UPDATE - ZPM can now be used as HULLMOD well sort of(this thing took whole weekend to code and bugfix so I hope you like it), thing is I cant make ZPMs disappear from invetory and doing so could lead to some nasty bugs and issues, so I opted fo next best thing and made them be required to be in invetory to use new hullmods, everything is explained in descriptions so no worries
 I added ZPMs to loot tables of derelict probles and survey ships so you can find them by doing exploration missions
 Next update:
 addition of new ship UNSF Hyperion, it will be transport ship wtih unique drones, sprite work is done it just needs to be implemented.
 Astraios and Fenrir are gettign finishing touches and will be added to markets
 Nebelheim system will be changed from placeholder planets to stable configuration so if everything goes smootly it will be safe compatible updates from that point on
changelog.0.85.0:
Stargate complex giving HUGE accessibility bonus is squashed
 ADDITIONS
 UNSF FACTION (yes thats right), market is still not finished but you can buy all weapons nad hullmods there
 UNSF STARSYSTEM (Nebelheim) with 3 planets, still WIP (use "goto nebelheim" command to find out where it is)
 FACTION MUSIC (only one song but its start)
 NEXT UPDATE - 3.9.2024
 hopefully all ships will be present in unsf faction market for now only Prometheus is there, why is that ? Because I am making updates very fast in all parts of mod and when I wake up in the morning I have new idea that I want to try to implement, hence reason why lot of different features are added but not finished - I call this "Honeymoon phase of modding".
